Founded in Faith

St. Elizabeth Catholic Hospital has been a beacon of healing in Ghana's Ahafo Region (previously Brong-Ahafo Region) for over five decades, guided by Catholic values of human dignity and compassion.

Our Story

World-Class Facilities,
Rooted in Compassion

Located in Hwidiem, St. Elizabeth Catholic Hospital serves as a regional centre of excellence for the Asutifi South District and surrounding communities — offering a wide range of clinical services under one roof, 24 hours a day.

Our multidisciplinary team of physicians, nurses, and allied health professionals bring skill, empathy, and faith to every patient encounter — from routine outpatient visits to complex surgical procedures.

NewsJune 16, 2026

BREASTFEEDING IS THE EASIEST CHOICE

Breastfeeding offers immense benefits for both baby and mother. It provides perfect nutrition, antibodies, and DHA for strong immunity, brain development, and emotional bonding, while helping babies develop healthy jaws and teeth. Challenges like sore nipples can be overcome with patience and a positive mindset. It saves families money, helps mothers lose pregnancy weight faster, and burns extra calories daily. Breast size does not limit milk supply — frequent nursing, nutrition, and hydration do. Contrary to fears, breastfeeding does not ruin breast shape more than age or gravity. By Pearl Exornam Selormey, Nutritionist
